traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text:
The ghoul wolf has advantage on Wisdom
(Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text:
The ghoul wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a
creature if at least one of the ghoul wolf’s allies is within 5 feet of the
creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The ghoul wolf makes two attacks: one with its bite and
one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10
(2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:
8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf
or undead, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be
paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end
of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
